reviews.body: Thank you for the contribution. I left a few comments, mostly about the docstring wording and some extra test cases.

review_comments.body: Please update the doctoring since with this change the params are forwarded on both v1, and v2 paths.
Let's add a test for the case where no `model_params` are given, so we know chat isn't called with unexpected kwargs.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review, Amir! I updated the `model_params` docstring to cover both interface versions and added cases that omit `model_params` to the sync and async tests. Both input forms now check that Cohere's `chat` receives only `messages` and `model` when no parameters are provided. All 20 Cohere unit tests passed.

_This follow-up was prepared with assistance from an AI coding agent._
